SUMMARY & PURPOSE

Responsive grid template for approved customer statements, with default example copy clearly identified as illustrative.

WHEN IT WORKS (IDEAL FOR)
•
Presenting approved customer statements with speaker roles and organizations
WHEN IT IS INAPPROPRIATE (AVOID FOR)
•
Publishing unapproved statements, identities, or ratings
JOBS TO BE DONE
Display approved customer statements with speaker role and organization
EXPECTED CONTENT REQUIREMENTS
Replace illustrative quotes with approved statements; provide a rating only when supported by a supplied value
